name: Paystack

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED. Header `x-paystack-signature`; HMAC-SHA512 of the RAW request body keyed with the live/test secret key, hex-encoded. No timestamp in the signature, so a valid payload is replayable — replay strategy must be event-id dedup plus the documented IP allowlist (52.31.139.75, 52.49.173.169, 52.214.14.220) plus a server-side call to /transaction/verify before fulfilment. Retries: every 3 min x4, then hourly up to 72h (live). Note SHA-512, not SHA-256 — the single most-hallucinated detail for this provider.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: VERIFIED. Secret `^sk_(test|live)_[A-Za-z0-9]+$`, public `^pk_(test|live)_[A-Za-z0-9]+$`. Same prefix convention as Stripe, which makes secret-scanning rules ambiguous — disambiguate by API host, not prefix.

fees.notes: VERIFIED for Nigeria local cards: 1.5% + NGN 100, the NGN 100 waived under NGN 2,500, total capped at NGN 2,000. International 3.9% + NGN 100. Per-country pricing differs materially (GHS/ZAR/KES schedules are separate) — do not extrapolate the NG number.

notes: The default developer on-ramp for Nigeria and the closest thing in this cluster to Stripe-grade DX; no shipped provider can accept NGN at all. Also the cheapest path to Verve cards, NUBAN virtual-account transfers and USSD, which together outweigh cards in Nigerian volume.

SDKs: No first-party server SDKs. Community libraries only (`paystack-node`/`paystack-sdk` on npm, `paystack` on PyPI, `yabacon/paystack-php`). Generator should emit direct REST + fetch/requests/Guzzle rather than pick a community package.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps Flutterwave in NG/GH/KE/ZA/CI. Paystack wins on DX and NG depth; Flutterwave wins on breadth. Ship both, route by country count.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
